description: Frozen General Draft Board methodology: Draft Probability, Draft Order, and the combination that produces the Overall Score. Values here are read at runtime (folds, feature_set, draft_size_by_year); the *_frozen blocks document the selected configuration and mirror the constants in src/board/ — the Python constants are the source of truth, this file is the reviewable record.

SET_2R_REDUCED.derivation: SET_2 minus four features removed for mathematical/structural redundancy, never by validation score

removed.rim_attempt_share: exact linear combination of layup+dunk+tip attempt shares (max deviation 0.0000000000); |r|=0.846 with layup_attempt_share
removed.efg_pct: |r|=0.939 with ts_pct, which is strictly more complete (includes free throws)
removed.fg_pct: |r|=0.856 with efg_pct and 0.792 with ts_pct; fully subsumed

draft_order_frozen.display_rule: output is an ORDERING; the numeric predicted pick is never shown to a user (MAE 13.3 of 60 picks)

draft_size_provenance: Source: docs/DATA.md 'total picks per draft', a structural property of each draft independent of the population definition.
Correction: 2014 is 60, not 59 as some secondary sources record — pick 60 (Cory Jefferson, San Antonio) is present in data/raw/draft_targets/draft_targets_2014.csv.
Validated: for every year the maximum pick observed among NCAA drafted early entrants is <= the declared draft size.

general_board_frozen.formula: final_board_signal = draft_probability * draft_slot_utility(draft_order_predicted_pick); Overall Score = percentile_rank(final_board_signal) * 100, rounded to an integer

notes: 2026 is never loaded. No fold references it.
Every transformer is fitted on training years only, inside each fold.
No threshold or blend weight is fitted or optimised on validation data.
See docs/METHODOLOGY.md for why each configuration was selected and docs/VALIDATION.md for the full evidence.
